title: Claude Code Dynamic Workflows: Run Hundreds of Parallel Subagents on a Single Task
summary: Claude Code dynamic workflows are now GA. Learn how to use ultracode and orchestration scripts to run parallel subagents on complex tasks in 2026.
body_markdown: Both start a dynamic workflow.` Ultracode` is the hands-off path — you enable the setting once and Claude decides automatically when your task warrants orchestration. Asking "Create a workflow" directly starts one immediately on that specific prompt. Use` ultracode` when you want Claude to judge the scope. Use the direct ask when you've already made that decision yourself.
